results.note: and/or swap in the reserved-character guard: a step containing only '@' or only '/' is no longer refused and falls through to the deep/preset parsing.
empty-step guard neutered: a split token is never None, so an empty step (e.g. --ai ',deep' or 'x,,deep') passes through instead of being refused.
wrong string in the refusal sentence: the corrective spelling it offers names <file> instead of <rung>, misdirecting the person to a spelling that does not exist.
boundary flip in the plural: zero clean lines now prints '0 line' instead of '0 lines'.
swapped argument in the count line: the conflict-hunks figure now reports the diff-hunk line count, so the two numbers under the headline are the same value.
inverted condition on the nudge: the ',deep' hint appears exactly when the plan already ran deep, and is silent when it did not.
dropped the label condition: a deep step that ran on any other file suppresses this file's nudge, so a clean-merged file under a recipe-only plan loses its hint whenever some other file ran deep.
inverted the capability check in doctor: a backend with tools is described as 'no tools: ... reaches file, not neighbours', and a backend without tools is told it may reach neighbours and project.
wrong string in doctor's no-tools sentence: it now claims the opposite latitude, telling the person the deep step reaches neighbours when it cannot.
default --ai-scope rung raised from 1 to 2: a plan that never passed --ai-scope now lets the deep step reach neighbours by default instead of stopping at the file.
